create.name: Richard Moss
create.bio:
Richard Moss is an American teacher of awareness and spiritual awakening who trained as a physician, taking his MD at New York Medical College in 1972 and practising emergency medicine. In 1977 a spontaneous awakening experience led him to leave medical practice; after nearly a year of meditation and study of spiritual and depth-psychological writing, he began teaching what he had come to understand about attention, presence and the habits of mind that keep people from them. For close to fifty years he has led retreats and shorter programmes across the United States, Europe, South America and Australia, and has spoken at Harvard, Stanford and UC Berkeley.

His central method, the Mandala of Being, is a simple map of the four places attention goes when we leave the present moment, used to recognise and step out of self-limiting stories. He draws on Eastern and Western traditions, dreamwork and relationship as a spiritual path, and now works mostly through one-to-one mentoring, regular online satsangs with his wife Katherine, and retreats in North Carolina and France. His books include The Black Butterfly, The I That Is We, The Mandala of Being and Inside-Out Healing, and he teaches on The Shift Network.

books.title: The Mandala of Being: Discovering the Power of Awareness
books.author: Richard Moss
books.description: A practical guide to the four places attention goes when we are not present: stories about the past, the future, ourselves and others. Using a simple mandala, it shows how to notice these habits and return to the present moment, with exercises for everyday life. This is the 2025 New World Library edition.

books.title: The Black Butterfly: An Invitation to Radical Aliveness
books.author: Richard Moss
books.description: Moss's first book, written about ten years after the awakening that led him to leave medicine, and reissued in 2026. It explores unconditional love, energy, intimacy, aloneness and what he calls radical aliveness.

books.title: The I That Is We: Awakening to Higher Energies Through Unconditional Love
books.author: Richard Moss
books.description: An account of Moss's spiritual awakening and the years of exploration that followed. It looks at individual and group energy, and at turning attention towards sharing and unconditional love.

books.title: Inside-Out Healing: Transforming Your Life Through the Power of Presence
books.author: Richard Moss
books.description: Principles, tools and exercises for working with self-limiting patterns of thought and behaviour by staying present with difficult feelings. It draws on stories from his individual sessions and applies the Mandala of Being to everyday life.

courses.title: Satsang with Richard and Katherine: Master Class in Awareness and the Path of Love
courses.description: A monthly subscription to twice-monthly online satsangs with Richard Moss and his wife Katherine, mixing guided meditation, teaching and open questions. Sessions run in English and in a French-translated version, and recordings are sent to all subscribers.

courses.title: Individual Mentoring
courses.description: Ninety-minute one-to-one mentoring sessions by Zoom or at his home in North Carolina, combining conversation with guided experiential teaching. Sessions usually start weekly or fortnightly and settle into a monthly rhythm.

free_resources.title: The Legacy Teachings: Live the Power of Now and Master the Power of Presence
free_resources.description: Two free audio e-courses on his Mandala of Being approach, eight sessions each with guided meditations and practices. Part one covers living in the present; part two goes deeper into how the mind creates emotional states. They are accessed through his community app.

free_resources.title: Listen: Talks and Meditations
free_resources.description: Free audio talks and contemplations to play on his website, on themes such as attention, uncertainty and the present moment. Includes short pieces like Who We Are Begins Now and Sipping Tea in the Early Morning.

free_resources.title: Gratitude: The Copenhagen Talks
free_resources.description: A free four-part recorded talk given in Copenhagen on gratitude as a practice and on the self-awareness needed to stop seeing the world only through the mind.
